## Libraries 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## A large vector (series) of numbers

```{r}
large_sequence <- seq(from = 1, to = 1e9)
# large_sequence
```

## Vectorized operation in R

```{r}
system.time(large_sequence * 2)
```


## For Loop operation in R

```{r}
system.time(
  for (n in large_sequence) {
    n * 2
  }
)
```
